response.sql:
WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY rfistat
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS baseline_avg
  FROM status_averages
), kept AS (
  SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex, b.baseline_avg
  FROM status_averages AS sa
  CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
  WHERE sa.avg_modindex > b.baseline_avg
), kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS mean_kept_avg
  FROM kept
)
SELECT k.rfistat AS rfistat,
       k.avg_modindex AS avg_modindex,
       k.avg_modindex - k.baseline_avg AS above_baseline,
       k.avg_modindex - km.mean_kept_avg AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept AS k
CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS km;

assumptions.assumption: SQLite GROUP BY places all NULL rfistat values in one group, so missing statuses form their own group; AVG ignores NULL modindex values, and a status with no non-NULL modindex has a NULL average and is not kept.
